rationale: Canonical lifecycle owns visual styles, DPI mode, and Application.Run behavior.
Canonical PortableThreadContext coalesces typed dispatcher posts and honors subscriber removal.
Canonical ThreadContext and typed dispatcher providers own isolated concurrent loops, control marshaling, per-thread ExitThread, no-form loops, context disposal, and public exit events.
Canonical lifecycle owns parenting/events/order, disposal and logical-handle cleanup, invalidation, and designer initialization; fake-only writable indexer and repaint semantics are excluded.
Canonical lifecycle owns CreateGraphics clipping, flush, and continued drawing.

Canonical Cursor owns bounded managed CUR selection, PNG and 32-bpp DIB decoding, alpha/AND-mask semantics, drawing, malformed-input rejection, and harmless shared-cursor disposal; stock shapes remain typed host transport.

Canonical lifecycle owns MaskedTextBox validation plus typed custom editing controls, DataTable binding, and managed System.Drawing cell painting; portable navigation-key state no longer calls USER32.

Canonical lifecycle owns handle-driven geometry, typed hit testing/current-cell behavior, editing-panel text and combo lifecycles, and portable pointer routing; reduced-runtime host/source probes are excluded.
Canonical lifecycle owns case-insensitive named lookup, typed column indexing, stable sorting, new-row placement, sort metadata/events, and guarded-sort behavior.
Canonical lifecycle owns placeholder creation/toggling, supported row insertion, clear/detach behavior, column-shape synchronization, row sharing, and guarded removal.

Canonical Control and ILibreDispatcher own thread affinity, synchronous/asynchronous marshaling, arguments/results, exception propagation, same-thread draining, and disposal; reduced-only generic Action<T> overloads are excluded.

Canonical Control and ILibreDragDropService own data transfer, target registration, AllowDrop parent fallback, effects, enter/over/leave/drop sequencing, cancellation, feedback, and cleanup; native shell ingress remains adapter debt.
Canonical lifecycle owns modeless ownership, owner-close, TopMost, and KeysConverter contracts; keyboard routing has separate canonical coverage.
Move event binding and CodeDom serialization vectors to canonical design tests.
Move selection, layout, toolbox, adorners, and smoke-source assertions to canonical owners.

The unchanged SDK consumer owns root/global/local verb merging, selection and type-refresh caching, canonical in-place global updates, exact and virtual command lookup/invocation, and disposal; reduced cache-replacement assertions are excluded.

The unchanged SDK consumer owns defaults, getter-only SharpDevelop overrides, 2..200 clamping, the DesignerOptions page, and Options.Properties setting; reduced forwarding properties and its WindowsFormsDesigner page are excluded.

The unchanged SDK consumer owns snap-line enums, state, matching, hosted edge/margin/padding offsets, priorities, and public designer overrides; standalone-parent offsets from the reduced comparison are excluded.
Move cleanup and keyboard-navigation behavior; retire only Portable service aliases.

Unchanged canonical SDK consumer owns stock cursors/conversion, buffering, selective command input, menu ownership/popup close reasons, ToolStrip forwarding/collections/overflow, border validation, and file-dialog configuration; compatibility-only cursor kinds are excluded.
Unchanged canonical SDK consumer owns KeyEventArgs masking/suppression and ScrollEventArgs constructor behavior; stale 0x5D assertion corrected to upstream's undefined 0xFF case.
Canonical lifecycle owns ProcessCmdKey bubbling, typed modifiers, message filters, and removal behavior.
Move selection, loader, filtering, serialization, paint, and editor contracts.
Canonical lifecycle owns handle-backed AutoScroll metrics/offsets, padding, displayed coordinates, canonical scaling, and embedded-editor placement.
Canonical lifecycle and ProGPU tests own typed measurement and managed drawing.
Canonical lifecycle owns image-driven bounds, public hit testing, expansion/collapse, selection/visibility, keyboard navigation, check events, and typed portable rendering.
